_comment: Mutations that reintroduce the START_STRATEGY command-path hole.
The bot starts a strategy through a SECOND door than the HTTP route:
the Redis command channel. `_handle_start_strategy_command` is the only
consumer of the START_STRATEGY command, and it must refuse to start a
strategy that arms 'breakeven_on_regime_change' on a deployment whose
screener feed cannot deliver the regime data.
M1 is the HOLE re-opened: the refusal never fires. The refusal tests
must fail.
M2 is the FALSE POSITIVE: the feed check is dropped, so the guard refuses
a protection that WOULD have worked. The positive control must fail.
M3 drops the REHYDRATE EXEMPTION: a replay of an already-approved
strategy is refused, and the user's running strategy vanishes after a
restart. The rehydrate test must fail.
M4 drops the REPLAY ALARM: the replay is still exempt from the refusal,
but nothing says its stop is inert. The replay-alarm test must fail.
M5 drops the APPROVAL-TIME check: an arming that appeared after the
approval (the API's PUT /config route does not apply the guard, and
the replay refreshes config_data from Postgres) inherits the
exemption. The armed-after-approval test must fail.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/strategy_command_path_guard.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: M1: the command-path guard never refuses anything (the hole, re-opened)
mutations.replace: if False:  # MUTANT: the command path never refuses

mutations.label: M2: the feed check is dropped, so the guard refuses a protection that WOULD have worked
mutations.replace: if regime_stop_armed:  # MUTANT: the feed check is dropped

mutations.label: M3: the rehydrate exemption is dropped, so a replay of an already-approved strategy is refused
M4: the replay alarm is never raised, so an inert replayed stop is silent
mutations.needle:
logger.critical(
                f"{log_prefix} REPLAYED a strategy that arms "
mutations.replace:
logger.info(
                f"{log_prefix} REPLAYED a strategy that arms "

mutations.label: M5: the approval-time check is dropped, so an arming made AFTER the approval inherits the exemption
mutations.replace: not regime_stop_armed or True  # MUTANT: the approval-time check is dropped
